question: What is the build number of the latest Autodesk Fusion release?
answer:
Based on Autodesk Fusion's October 2026 release, minor update v.2706.1.17, dated October 28, 2026 [1].

The latest build number in the sources is v.2706.1.17 [1]. It follows the October 2026 major update build v.2706.1.14, dated October 21, 2026 [1]. The v.2706.1.17 update covers stability fixes, including moving components or rolling back the timeline in assemblies and a blank Render workspace when a section analysis was active [1]. A search snippet from the Fusion blog lists the same build and date [7].
